name: io.github.identity-md-launches/imd-mcp
description: Experimental MCP server to hire the IMD swarm with quotes, capped payments, and job status.

environmentVariables.name: IMD_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional 0x signing key; unset keeps tools read-only.

environmentVariables.name: IMD_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Verify quotes without signing when true.

environmentVariables.name: IMD_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API base URL; override only for tests or mocks.
